      Release Notes

      Builder Overhaul Release

      Enterprise 3.2 Coffee Operations OS: Ready-to-Print Master Store Binder Export, In-Store iPad Interactive Workstation, Global Library Search, and Sanremo Café Racer Equipment Maintenance Schematics.

      Master Store Binder Export

      • Pre-Paginated Consolidated Manual: Compiles all 14 store documents into a single master binder with continuous running headers and footers (Page X of Total).
      • Official Brick Road Cover Page: Custom store operations cover with gold branding, title, subtitle, edition stamp, document counts, and management approval seal.
      • Categorized Table of Contents: Grouped into SOPs, Recipes, Clean Plays, and Order Sheets with dot leader guides leading to computed page numbers.
      • Standalone HTML & PDF Print: 1-click print to PDF or download as an offline self-contained HTML manual binder.

      In-Store Tablet Interactive Mode

      • Touch-Optimized Barista UI: Large 32px checkboxes with tactile check animations, strikethrough styling, and completion timestamps.
      • Inventory Counter Steppers: Touch [-] and [+] buttons with live Order = Par - On Hand calculations.
      • Real-Time Shift Progress Bar: Visual progress bar tracking % of shift tasks completed.
      • Offline Persistence: Automatically saves state to localStorage by document and shift (Open/Mid/Close).
      • Standalone iPad App Export: 1-click export of an offline standalone HTML checklist for the iPad Files app or Home Screen.

      Global Library Ingredient & Tool Search

      • Cross-Document Searching: Search across all loaded documents simultaneously for ingredients (e.g. "Oat Milk"), tools (e.g. "Acaia Scale"), equipment (e.g. "Refractometer"), and cleaning chemicals (e.g. "Cafiza").
      • Instant Highlighted Snippets: Shows matching field context with highlighted search terms.
      • 1-Click Jump & Pulse: Clicking any search result opens the document, scrolls the canvas, and pulses a golden highlight outline directly on the matching element.
      • Shortcut: Press Ctrl+Shift+F anywhere to search the library.

      Sanremo Café Racer Equipment Schematic & Maintenance Standard

      • Official Machine Architecture: Multi-boiler AISI 316L specs, PID temperature, 9.0 Bar pump pressure, 58mm naked portafilters, and 8.5mm conical silicone group gaskets.
      • Visual Hydraulic Diagram: 8-stage flow diagram from filtration through saturated multi-boiler to naked extraction.
      • Maintenance Procedures: Daily chemical backflush cycles (10s ON / 10s OFF), weekly shower screen removal, and monthly silicone gasket inspection.

      Intelligent SOP Scanner & Modular Block Recreator

      • Deep Hierarchy Scanning: Scans imported Word (.docx), Excel (.xlsx), and PDF SOPs and parses them into rich modular blocks instead of dumping raw unformatted text.
      • Automatic Equipment Grids: Scans "Materials needed" and tools to generate structured 2-column specification tables (Required Tool / Supply | Model / Spec & Designated Storage).
      • Recipe Formulation Matrices: Automatically detects ingredient lines, amounts, and yields to build 3-column recipe matrices (Ingredient / Component | Standard Amount | Preparation Notes).
      • Safety Warnings & Pro-Tip Callouts: Isolates critical directives into high-visibility safety cards (CAUTION:) and barista pro-tips (PRO-TIP:).
      • Store Unit Standardization: Automatically normalizes units across documents: °F, ppm, min, sec, fl oz, gal.
      • Zero-Overflow Auto-Pagination: Computes document weights and distributes steps across pages with running headers for clean, overflow-free printing.

      4-Tab Sidebar & Visual Builder Workstation

      • Blocks Toolbox: Visual catalog of 13 modular building blocks (Structure, Procedural, Tables, and Coffee Shop Visuals) with instant fuzzy search and 1-click addition.
      • Outline Tree: Hierarchical element tree with reorder buttons, settings, duplicate, delete, and jump-to-canvas focus.
      • Contextual Property Inspector: Real-time controls for tables (headings, row heights, column alignment, row color swatches, formula calculation) and sections (titles, overview text, steps, notes).
      • Pro Markdown Editor: Full-height markdown workstation with two-way synchronization between code, sidebar, and canvas.
      • Live Canvas Sync: Clicking any element on the canvas instantly synchronizes with the active Property Inspector or Outline node.

      Formula Engine & Formula Bar (fx)

      • Live Order Formulas: Type =PAR - OH, =MAX(0, B - C), =SUM(col), or =AVG(col). The engine evaluates formulas dynamically and updates live.
      • 1-Click Auto-Calculate: Click Auto-Calculate Order in Order Sheet mode to automatically apply par-minus-inventory calculations across the entire sheet.
      • Excel fx Formula Bar: Shows active cell coordinates (e.g. C3) and allows formula or value editing above the canvas.
      • Matrix Keyboard Traversal: Navigate between cells with ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Tab, and Enter (which commits and moves to the cell below).

      Proprietary Coffee Shop & Food Safety Visual Elements

      • Drink Cup Layer Diagram: Visual beverage cross-section illustrating syrup pumps, espresso crema, milk fill line, ice, and drizzle topping.
      • FDA Storage Rack Map: 5-tier walk-in cooler diagram enforcing FDA Food Code §3-302.11 vertical shelf standards.
      • Barista Station Flow Map: 8-node speed-of-service track preventing cross-traffic during morning rush.
      • Time & Temp Log: Inspection log with automatic safety badges (<41°F Safe Cool, 41-135°F Danger Zone, >135°F Safe Hot).
      • 3-Compartment Sink Guide: Universal wash, rinse, 60s Quat sanitize (200-400 PPM), and air-dry placard.

      Print Layout Inspector & Ergonomic Handles

      • Zero Cut-Off Printing: Scans pages before printing; if content exceeds 11 inches, offers 1-click Auto-Fit Scale (95% or 90%).
      • Tactile Drag Handles: 22×22px grab handles with 6-dot texture (⋮⋮) and tactile hover scale.
      • Running Headers & Footers: Automatic store name, title, and "Page X of Y" printed on every page.

      Document Type Switcher & Document Modes

      • Effortless Type Switching: Instantly switch between SOP, Recipe Card, Clean Play, and Order Sheet from the top navigation bar, status bar pill, or context menu.
      • Smart Content Conversion: Intelligently translates your active tables, steps, or tasks into the target format without losing information.
      • Rich Coffee Shop Standards: 1-click loading of complete reference templates for all 4 types.
      • Contextual Canvas Toolbars: Dynamic top-of-canvas quick actions specific to the active document type.

      Word & Excel Draggable Column Dividers

      • Interactive Column Dragging: Drag any vertical column divider on table headers to resize column widths in real time with a live guideline and dimension tooltip (inches + pixels).
      • Double-Click Auto-Fit: Double-click any column divider to automatically snap the column width to its widest cell content, just like Excel!
      • Undo / Redo Support: Column resizing operations save directly to document history (Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y) and Markdown export.

      Selection Formatting Mini-Toolbar

      • Instant Ribbon on Highlight: Highlighting any text on the page displays a floating mini-toolbar right above your selection.
      • Rich Typography Tools: 1-click Bold (**), Italic (*), Yellow Highlight (==), Pink Highlight (!!), and Label (~~).
      • Clear Formatting: 1-click Clear button strips all formatting tags instantly.

      Context Menu (Right-Click / Long-Press)

      • No Browser Interruption: Intercepts right-clicks everywhere across canvas, stage, and tables.
      • Table & Column Tools: Insert/delete rows & columns, toggle group rows, set custom column widths, and copy entire tables for Excel/Sheets.
      • Touch Devices: Long press for 500ms on touchscreens with an animated ripple indicator.

      Word-Style Live Metrics & Dual-Mode Editing

      • Real-Time Word & Reading Stats: Live word count, character count, document type pill, and estimated reading time directly in the bottom status bar.
      • Dual-Mode Canvas Unlocked: Click any text directly on canvas to edit freely while side panels stay open.
      • Export CSV & Markdown: Instant export to spreadsheets and Markdown documentation.

      Card Builder Features & User Guide

      Everything you need to know about building, formatting, and printing store documents in one unified Brick Road aesthetic.

      1-Click Page Type Switcher & Smart Conversion

      You can effortlessly switch any document between SOP, Recipe Card, Clean Play, and Order Sheet using the top navigation pill ([ SOP ▾ ]), the bottom status bar pill, or the universal right-click context menu. Choose Convert Content to intelligently adapt your existing headings, tables, and steps into the new format without losing data, or Load Template to start with a fresh coffee shop standard.

      Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

      • 1 or 2 Column Layouts: Switch effortlessly between 1-column detail and double-column compact multi-page layouts.
      • Callout Alert Boxes: Type or click to insert > CAUTION: (pink warning tint), > PRO-TIP: (yellow highlight), and > Time & Temp callouts.
      • Equipment & Supplies Table: Specialized 2-column requirements table mapping tools to target specifications and station locations.
      • Step Checklist Mode: Training checkboxes ([ ]) on each step for laminated dry-erase training checklists.

      Recipe Cards (Drink & Food Specs)

      • 1-Click HOT / ICED Toggle: Instant badge switch between Hot (warm yellow) and Iced (cool pink) recipe cards.
      • Dual Size Volumes: Header amounts for 16 oz and 20 oz (or custom sizes like 12 oz, 24 oz, or Pitcher).
      • Syrup Pump & Shot Matrix: Dedicated reference tables for espresso shots, Monin syrup pumps, sauce pumps, and milk temperatures.
      • Finish & Rim Line Specs: Highlighted rim guidelines (¼ in below rim) and quality notes for consistent presentation.
      • Dietary & Allergen Tags: 1-click tags for Vegan, Dairy-Free, Gluten-Free, and Nut warnings.

      Clean Play (Master Sanitation & Audits)

      • Interactive Checkboxes: Clickable checkmarks on daily tasks with automatic strikethrough completion.
      • Monday to Sunday Weekly Projects: Distinct color-coded day pills (Mon to Sun) for deep-clean rotation.
      • Shift Hand-Off Checklist: Opening, Mid-Day, and Closing shift breakdown tables with staff sign-off lines.
      • Sanitizer PPM & Food Safety Standards: Dedicated chemical dilution guidelines (200–400 PPM Quat, 180°F rinse).

      Order & Count Sheets (Inventory & Par)

      • Draggable Column Dividers: Move vertical column lines from ANY point of the table with live dimension tooltips.
      • 8 Print-Safe Row Colors: Highlight critical counts, par levels, or categories in yellow, mint, pink, ice, lavender, peach, or gray.
      • Order & Delivery Schedule Subtitles: Dedicated visual schedule builder for recurring cut-off and delivery days.
      • BOH Freezer Layout Chart: Visual shelf layout for Single Door, Double Door, or Dual freezer units.
      • Vendor & Repacking Guides: Vendor contacts, order due times, minimum order sizes, and box repack notes.

      Master Store Binder Export

      Consolidate your entire store operations library into a single pre-paginated master manual with a formal cover page, categorized Table of Contents, and continuous page numbering.

      Official Cover Page

      Features Brick Road Coffee branding, edition stamp, document counts, and manager approval seal, perfectly formatted for standard 8.5" $ imes$ 11" 3-ring binder front covers.

      Categorized Table of Contents

      Automatically organizes SOPs, Recipes, Clean Plays, and Order Sheets with dot leader lines leading to exact computed start page numbers.

      Continuous Running Headers & Footers

      Every page receives unified running headers (BRICK ROAD COFFEE · OPERATIONS & STANDARDS MANUAL) and continuous global page footers (Page X of Total).

      Standalone HTML & PDF Export

      Print directly to PDF via the browser print dialog or download an offline self-contained HTML manual that can be archived or shared.

      In-Store iPad / Tablet Interactive Workstation

      A touch-first operational interface designed specifically for behind-the-bar iPads and walk-in tablets, with persistent local checklists and inventory steppers.

      Tactile 32px Touch Checkboxes

      Large tap targets with satisfying checkmark animations, automatic text strikethrough, and live completion timestamps (e.g. Checked by Sarah at 10:45 AM).

      Inventory Stepper Controls

      Touch-friendly [-] and [+] buttons with auto-calculating Order = Par - Count deltas for walk-in and dry storage counts.

      Shift Switching & Progress Bar

      Filter between Morning Open, Mid-Day Rush, and Evening Close shifts with a live progress bar tracking percentage of tasks completed.

      1-Click Standalone iPad Web App

      Download a standalone offline HTML file that baristas can save to the iPad Files app or add to the iPad Home Screen with zero server requirements.

      Equipment Schematics & Maintenance Tooling

      Author professional machine architecture schematics, hydraulic flow diagrams, and preventive maintenance guides for espresso machines, grinders, and brewers.

      Sanremo Café Racer Official Standard

      Pre-packaged authentic maintenance guide featuring AISI 316L multiboiler specs, PID temperature controls, 9.0 Bar gear pump, 58mm naked portafilters, and 8.5mm conical silicone group gaskets.

      Daily Chemical Backflush Protocol

      Step-by-step chemical cavitation backflushing instructions with exact timing cycles ( 10s ON / 10s OFF $ imes$ 5) and steam wand Rinza purge directives.

      Weekly & Monthly Service Checklists

      Shower screen removal and brass dispersion block scrub procedures, plus monthly 8.5mm silicone gasket inspection to prevent blowouts during rush.

      Custom Schematic Builder

      Use the Property Inspector in the sidebar to customize machine names, specs, hydraulic flow stages, and maintenance intervals for any equipment in the shop.

      Intelligent SOP Scanner & Modular Block Recreator

      Import already created SOPs (.docx, .pdf, .xlsx), have them scanned and parsed, and recreate them inside the builder using native modular blocks instead of unformatted flat text.

      Structured Section Hierarchy

      • Phase & Procedure Extraction: Scans document headings, subtitles, and bold lead-ins to generate structured procedure phases (e.g. Phase 1: Initial Setup, Phase 2: Brewing, Phase 3: Refractometer Calibration).
      • No Flat Text Collapsing: Keeps steps, sub-steps, and overview directives cleanly separated across dedicated section cards.

      Tool & Equipment Tables

      • Automatic Grid Parsing: Detects "Materials needed", "Tools & Supplies", and equipment lists.
      • Structured 2-Column Tables: Automatically builds Required Tool / Supply | Model / Spec & Designated Storage with designated storage tags for Cambros, Acaia scales, digital refractometers, and nitro kegs.

      Recipe Formulation Matrices

      • Ingredient Grids: When recipe SOPs or syrup cooking guides are imported, ingredients and amounts are mapped into Ingredient / Component | Standard Amount | Preparation Notes.
      • Operational Metadata: Automatically extracts batch yields, prep time, shelf life, and storage targets into metadata chips.

      Safety Directives & Pro-Tips

      • Caution Alert Cards: Critical safety rules, chemical warnings, and food storage directives (e.g. "Store in bottom of BOH fridge") are converted into high-visibility CAUTION: callouts.
      • Barista Best Practices: Helpful advice and calibration tips become PRO-TIP: cards.

      Unit Standardization

      • Consistent Store Formats: Normalizes diverse document styles into store standards: °F, °C, ppm, min, sec, fl oz, gal.

      Smart Multi-Page Auto-Pagination

      • Zero Overflows Guaranteed: Dynamically balances procedural steps and tables across pages.
      • Running Headers: Automatically creates continued headers (e.g. Title · Section Name (cont.)) on subsequent pages.

      Reactive Excel Formulas & fx Formula Bar

      Type formulas directly into any table cell: =PAR - OH, =MAX(0, B - (C + D)), =SUM(col), or =AVG(col). The builder evaluates formulas in real time, displays computed numbers, and lets you edit the raw formula either in the cell or in the Excel-style fx Formula Bar above the canvas. In Order mode, click Auto-Calculate Order to instantly populate calculations across all rows!

      Matrix Keyboard Traversal (Arrow Keys & Enter)

      Move seamlessly across spreadsheet grid cells using ArrowUp and ArrowDown. Press Enter to commit and move directly to the cell below (row + 1), or press Tab to cycle across columns. Pressing Enter on the bottom row automatically appends a new blank row.

      Interactive Column Resizing Anywhere on the Line

      Hover near the divider between any two columns — at the header, inside any row, or in category rows — to reveal the resize cursor. Drag anywhere along the line to adjust column widths smoothly with live guidelines and inch/pixel tooltips.

      Double-Click Auto-Fit & Custom Inch Widths

      Double-click any column divider to snap its width directly to the widest content in that column (just like Excel). Right-click any column header to specify an exact measurement in inches (e.g. 1.75 in), or click Auto-fit all columns.

      Row & Category Background Colors

      Right-click any row to open the Row Color palette. Highlight key rows in Yellow, Soft Pink, Mint Green, Ice Blue, Lavender, Peach, or Warm Gray. Category group rows (# ) also support custom accent colors.

      Alignment & Excel TSV Copy

      Right-click table headers or cells to set Align: Left, Center, Right, or Currency ($) (tabular numeric alignment). Click Copy table to Excel / Sheets to copy clean tab-delimited text ready to paste directly into spreadsheets.

      Free Canvas with Pan & Zoom

      Documents sit on an unconstrained canvas. Hold Space or the middle mouse button to pan freely, or Ctrl + scroll to zoom. Use the bottom-right bar for Fit width, Fit page, 100%, and Stacked / Side by side views.

      Selection Formatting Mini-Toolbar

      Highlight any text on the page to summon a floating formatting ribbon right above your cursor: B (Bold), I (Italic), Highlight (Yellow), Warning (Pink), Label (Small caps), and Clear.

      Spreadsheet Navigation

      Click any cell to type. Press Tab to move to the next cell and Enter to move to the cell below. The dotted handle on the left lets you reorder rows, steps, or whole sections by drag-and-drop.

      Visual Order & Delivery Schedule Builder

      No more typing ==Sunday== Order → ==Monday== Delivery by hand! Click the Edit Schedule button on the canvas or in the context menu to choose order and delivery days with visual dropdowns or 1-click presets.

      Fill-In Blank Presets

      Add standardized date lines, counted-by blanks, and manager sign-offs with one click.

      Drink Cup Build Layer Diagram

      A stylized cross-section diagram showing exact beverage layers: syrup pumps, espresso doppio, milk fill line, ice level, and cold foam / caramel drizzle toppings. Available via the + Cup Diagram button in Recipe and SOP modes.

      Storage Rack Map

      A 5-shelf stainless cooler rack diagram enforcing FDA Food Code §3-302.11 vertical shelf hierarchy (Top Shelf: Ready-to-Eat Foods → Shelf 2: Dairy & Milks → Shelf 3: Raw Beef & Pork 145°F → Shelf 4: Ground Meats 155°F → Bottom Shelf: Raw Poultry 165°F). Insert via + Storage Rack in Order and SOP modes.

      Barista Station Flow Map

      An 8-node ergonomic workstation map mapping ticket flow from POS → Grinder → Espresso → Rinser → Fridge → Ice → Syrups → Hand-off to eliminate barista cross-traffic collisions during morning rush. Insert via + Station Flow Map in SOP mode.

      Time & Temperature Verification Log

      Food safety monitoring table with automated visual indicator badges: <41°F Safe Cool (Green), 41°F–135°F Danger Zone (Pink alert), and >135°F Safe Hot (Amber). Insert via + Temp Log.

      3-Compartment Sink Sanitation Standards

      BOH sanitation placard detailing Sink 1 Wash (110°F), Sink 2 Rinse (110°F), Sink 3 Sanitize (Quat 200–400 PPM, 60s soak), and Stage 4 Air Dry with Quat test paper color matching swatches. Insert via + 3-Compartment Sink in Clean Play mode.

      Print Layout Inspector

      Card Builder scans pages before opening the print dialog. If content exceeds 11 inches, an alert presents 1-click Auto-Fit Scale (95% or 90%) to guarantee zero cut-off pages or overflow paper waste.

      4-Tab Sidebar & Visual Builder Workstation

      The sidebar has been completely overhauled from a monolithic form into a modern 4-tab workstation designed for rapid operational document authoring:

      • Blocks: Searchable visual component tray. Add sections, cards, page breaks, hazard callouts, pro-tips, order tables, pump matrices, and proprietary coffee shop diagrams with 1 click.
      • Outline: Document structural tree. Reorder sections with controls, jump to canvas position, duplicate blocks, or customize properties.
      • Props: Contextual Property Inspector. When you click any table or section on canvas or in outline, edit its heading, row heights, column alignment, row color tints, and order formulas in real time.
      • Pro: Markdown code editor with two-way live editing and syntax guidance.

      ◨ Sidebar Toggle & Resizable Splitter

      Click the ◀ Sidebar button in the top bar or press Ctrl+\ to toggle the left menu at any time. When closed, a floating pull-tab on the left edge lets you reopen it instantly. Drag the splitter to adjust sidebar width; double-click to reset.

      Dual-Mode Live Synchronization

      Canvas editing remains 100% live even with the Visual or Form Editor open. Edits on canvas immediately update the side panel, and side-panel changes update the canvas.

      True Letter PDF Print

      Click Print… (Ctrl+P) to generate print-ready PDFs strictly matching Letter size (8.5 × 11 in) with crisp vector graphics, embedded base64 fonts, and clean page breaks.

      Bulk Import & CSV Export

      Bulk import Word (.docx), Excel (.xlsx), CSV, PDF, and JSON bundles. File > Export tables to CSV extracts tables into spreadsheet-ready data files.
